extraction.Name: Cornelius Ellston
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded March 30, 1918, by Volz Abstract Company
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to W. H. Tackett for $2000 on April 2, 1918; mortgaged to W. S. Slaughter for $5000 on October 28, 1921 (foreclosed in 1925); mortgaged to C. H. McNulty for $11,000 on July 20, 1923, mortgage assigned to Merchants National Bank of Omaha, then foreclosed in June 1925
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612805; land described as east half of Northeast quarter, northeast quarter of southeast quarter, section 22, and Northwest quarter of northwest quarter section 23, township 97, north of range 74; receipt for patent signed February 14, 1918, by the allottee; Ellston and wife were parties to the mortgages
